name: GMW Fixes
description: Gideon's Gaming's fixes for The Galaxy's Most Wanted, rebuilt as full cards by Bluefire. Installing it offers the Balanced version when a Galaxy's Most Wanted campaign starts (Collector I-III and The Grand Collection, Nebula's Ship, the Milano, Interception Imminent and Take What Is Mine), and its rebuilt faces show in Balanced games.

permission.by: Gideon's Gaming (the errata); Bluefire (the rebuilt cards and the Spanish)
permission.evidence: The curated repository's record: https://github.com/bluefireF5ran/mc-digital-custom-packs/blob/a51e50da556ece0b0fe9a75848320416b8794cef/gmw_fixes_gg/mod.json (permission: status "granted", scope "inclusion"; version "1.0 (approved 2026-11-03)"); confirmed by the project owner (Quin Carter) on 2026-11-13. The errata's source: https://gideonsgaming.com/marvel-champions-fixing-galaxys-most-wanted/
permission.scope: inclusion (as the source records it); the Spanish faces are Bluefire's own translation and rebuild
permission.note: The source gives no date for the grant; 2026-11-13 is the owner's confirmation. Its scope says "inclusion" only: the Spanish is covered as Bluefire's own work, not by a separate grant from Gideon's Gaming.
